cohort: The study included 300 primiparous breastfeeding mothers referring to healthcare centers in Mashhad, Iran.
finding: Maternal self-esteem is positively related to breastfeeding self-efficacy, with a 0.779 increase in breastfeeding self-efficacy score for each score increase in self-esteem.
mod_finding: Method of delivery was significantly related to breastfeeding self-efficacy (p=0.040) but not to maternal self-esteem.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from primiparous breastfeeding mothers during the postpartum breastfeeding period, with exact timing unspecified.
